summary: Texas County, Missouri tower in Gist Ranch CA: an 87-ft tower dated 1953 that MDC says has been sold and is no longer on site; sources disagree on the land date and early towers.

facts.design: Galvanized steel frame tower with an external steel ladder and a pyramid roof, built by the Aermotor Company
facts.status_note: MDC says the fire tower has been sold and is no longer on site. The MDC page gives no date for the sale.

access.note: The site is inside Gist Ranch Conservation Area, an MDC area. The survey lists camping, hunting and fishing there. The tower itself is no longer on site.

corrections.why: 15.8 m is 52 ft, the figure for an undated wood tower on the compiled list. The 1953 tower described by the 2015 plan and the survey is 87 ft (26.5 m).
The MDC page says the fire tower has been sold and is no longer on site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The compiled list gives 80 acres acquired in 1942. The survey gives an August 1952 acquisition from the previous owners. The story reports both and does not choose.
The compiled list gives a replacement tower in fiscal 1952-53. The survey gives December 1953 and the 2015 plan gives 1953. The story uses 1953 for the tower the survey and plan describe.
The compiled list gives 52 ft for an undated wood tower. The survey and the 2015 plan give 87 ft for the tower standing in their time.

notes_for_editor: Four sources. The MDC page is the only one that says the tower was sold and is no longer on site, and it gives no sale date. The survey section is the most detailed (builder, height, December 1953 date, NRHP recommendation), but its author and report title are not on the attachment. A GovDeals auction listing for removing this tower, with a window in late 2023 to early 2024, appeared in search snippets. It could not be fetched, so it is not cited. Wikimapia says the tower was staffed during high fire danger, but that page did not load, so staffing is left out. The land-date and early-tower conflicts are unresolved; the story reports both.
